On Your Turn
Each turn you can Move, take one Action, maybe one Bonus Action, and between turns one Reaction.
Actions
  • Cast a spell (see the Spell Reference pages)
  • Attack with a weapon or damaging cantrip (see Skills page)
  • Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Hide, Help, Search, Ready, Shove, Grapple, Influence, Study, Utilize
Bonus Actions

  • Divine Smite
Reactions
  • Opportunity Attack when a creature leaves your reach
  • Cast a spell with a Reaction casting time
House Rules
  • Catch your breath. Out of combat, spend one Hit Die + your Constitution modifier to heal. Up to 3 times all run; mark each on the Hit Dice track above.
  • Spellcasting. Cast any spell of a type you can cast from a found Spell Book, if you have the slots. You can reach one level above your normal maximum by spending two slots of the level just below it: two level-1 slots cast a level-2 spell, two level-2 slots cast a level-3 spell like Fireball. That over-level cast needs a spellcasting check (DC 10 + the spell's level). The slots are spent whether you pass or fail, and a failure fizzles the spell.

Who You Are

Your Ancestry: Dragonborn

Your ancestry gives you a few natural traits.

Draconic Ancestry. Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance. Draconic Ancestors. Dragon.
Breath Weapon. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time).
Damage Resistance. You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
Draconic Flight. When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or…
Your Background: Noble

You were raised in a castle, surrounded by wealth, power, and privilege. Your family of minor aristocrats ensured that you received a first-class education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented.

Trained Skills. History and Persuasion (already on your Skills page).
Tools. Choose one kind of Gaming Set.
Origin Feat. Skilled (explained under Your Feats).
Your Feats

Feats are special perks from your background and choices, on top of your class.

Defense. Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature). While you’re wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
Skilled. Origin Feat. You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.
Weapon Mastery. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.
Dark Bargain. A pact perk from your backstory. Confirm its exact effect with your DM before play.
Your Class: Paladin (Oathbreaker (DMG))

A Devout Warrior of Sacred Oaths. Paladins live on the front lines of the cosmic struggle, united by their oaths against the forces of annihilation. Primary Abilities: Strength & Charisma. Hit Point Die: D10. Saves: Wisdom & Charisma

The Vault of the Starving MindPage 4

Who You Are

An Oathbreaker is a paladin who breaks his or her sacred oaths to pursue some dark ambition or serve an evil power. Whatever light burned in the paladin’s heart has been extinguished. Only darkness remains.

Track your limited uses here. Each box is one use, and every per-rest use is doubled because this dungeon has no rest.
Lay On Hands: Healing Pool30 total
Spend points from your healing pool to restore Hit Points by touch, or end one poison or disease.
Channel Divinity
Spend a use to power a Channel Divinity option (Turn Undead or your domain's option).
Lay On Hands. Bonus Action (Healing Pool). You have a healing pool equal to five times your Paladin level. As a Bonus Action, touch a creature to restore Hit Points from the pool, or spend 5 points from it to end one disease or the Poisoned condition. Track the pool on your usage boxes above.
Channel Divinity. Channel Divinity use. You can channel divine power for special effects. You start with Divine Sense, plus your oath's option below. Track uses on your usage boxes above.
Divine Sense. Magic action (Channel Divinity use). For 10 minutes, you know the location and type of any Celestial, Fiend, or Undead within 60 ft that isn't behind Total Cover.
Paladin's Smite. Free (once per run). You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared, and once without spending a spell slot (normally recharges on a Long Rest, so treat it as once for this run).
Weapon Mastery. Passive. You can use the mastery property of two kinds of weapons you chose.
Control Undead. Magic action (Channel Divinity use). Target one Undead within 30 ft; it must succeed on a Charisma save or obey your commands for 24 hours.
Dreadful Aspect. Magic action (Channel Divinity use). Creatures of your choice within 30 ft must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Frightened of you for 1 minute.

Spell Slots
Cross off a box when you cast a leveled spell.
Level 1
Level 1 Spells — each casting spends a slot
CommandLevel 1 Enchantment
Casting Time: ActionRange: 60 ftComponents: VDuration: Instantaneous
Saving throw

You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options:

Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.

Halt. On its turn, the target doesn’t move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Divine FavorLevel 1 Transmutation
Casting Time: Bonus ActionRange: SelfComponents: V, SDuration: 1 minute

Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.

Hellish RebukeLevel 1 Evocation
Casting Time: ReactionRange: 60 ftComponents: V, SDuration: Instantaneous
Saving throw

The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.
